enum.name: POD_DAA_FLAGS
enum.description: Status flags for POD_DAA_TRACK_ARRAY civil DAA summary.

entry.name: POD_DAA_FLAG_EO_VALID
entry.description: Electro-optical camera ring track observation is valid.

entry.name: POD_DAA_FLAG_LWIR_VALID
entry.description: 8-14 um LWIR radiometric thermal observation is valid.

entry.name: POD_DAA_FLAG_CBDR_ALERT
entry.description: Constant Bearing Decreasing Range caution active.

entry.name: POD_DAA_FLAG_SHADOW_ONLY
entry.description: Shadow-mode advisory only; zero closed-loop actuator authority.

enum.name: POD_BOSON_FFC_STATE
enum.description: FLIR Boson+ manual Flat-Field Correction (FFC) state.

entry.name: POD_BOSON_FFC_IDLE
entry.description: No FFC active; streaming calibrated radiometric frames.

entry.name: POD_BOSON_FFC_PENDING
entry.description: Manual FFC scheduled between non-critical intervals.

entry.name: POD_BOSON_FFC_IN_PROGRESS
entry.description: Internal shutter closed for manual FFC calibration.

entry.name: POD_BOSON_FFC_COMPLETE
entry.description: Manual FFC completed nominally.

entry.name: POD_RTA_INVALID_INHIBIT
entry.description: Invalid/inhibited state; conformal overlays and neural advisories blanked.

entry.name: POD_RTA_FALLBACK_D0_SAFE
entry.description: Verified baseline D0 safe fallback active.

entry.name: POD_RTA_DEGRADED_COAST
entry.description: Degraded inertial/coastal navigation within bounded uncertainty.

entry.name: POD_RTA_ISOLATED_5CAM
entry.description: Single-camera fault isolated; 5-camera ring operating nominally.

entry.name: POD_RTA_NOMINAL_ML
entry.description: Full 6-camera nominal ML operation within verified envelope.

enum.name: POD_VLM_HAZARD_TYPE
enum.description: DR-09 civil semantic hazard taxonomy (1:1 parity with xvs.v2.xvs_vlm_gate.VlmHazard).

entry.name: POD_VLM_HAZARD_NONE
entry.description: No semantic hazard detected.

entry.name: POD_VLM_HAZARD_RUNWAY_INCURSION
entry.description: Vehicle, aircraft, or pedestrian obstructing active runway.

entry.name: POD_VLM_HAZARD_BIRD_FLOCK
entry.description: Flock of birds or wildlife hazard along flight path.

entry.name: POD_VLM_HAZARD_CONVECTIVE_VIRGA
entry.description: Localized convective virga, microburst shaft, or severe weather cell.

entry.name: POD_VLM_HAZARD_CRANE_PROXY
entry.description: Uncharted temporary crane, mast, tower, or thin vertical civil obstruction.

entry.name: POD_VLM_HAZARD_FLZ_HAZARD
entry.description: Semantic surface obstacle or crowd hazard within candidate Forced Landing Zone.

enum.name: POD_VLM_GATE_VERDICT
enum.description: Deterministic 6-stage DO-178C DAL B/C VLM gate status (1:1 parity with xvs.v2.xvs_vlm_gate.GateStatus).

entry.name: POD_VLM_GATE_NOMINAL_ADVISORY
entry.description: VLM advisory passed all 6 verification stages (nominal or confirmed M-of-N veto).

entry.name: POD_VLM_GATE_VLM_OFFLINE
entry.description: VLM watchdog timeout or non-monotonic sequence; fallback to geometric monitors.

entry.name: POD_VLM_GATE_SCHEMA_OR_CRC_FAIL
entry.description: Wire packet failed fixed schema, range check, or IEEE CRC32 validation.

entry.name: POD_VLM_GATE_OPTICAL_ODD_MASKED
entry.description: Optical ODD degraded (fog/glare/droplets/blur/attitude); VLM masked cleanly.

entry.name: POD_VLM_GATE_CONFORMAL_ABSTAIN
entry.description: Conformal prediction abstention (conformal_valid_bit == 0); never treated as clear.

entry.name: POD_VLM_GATE_DEBOUNCE_PENDING
entry.description: Hazard seen but M-of-N temporal confirmation threshold not yet reached.

enum.name: POD_PLUGIN_LIFECYCLE_STATE
enum.description: DR-16 OpenXVS-OS Ring-1 plugin supervisor lifecycle state (deterministic PLUGIN_OFFLINE latch).

entry.name: POD_PLUGIN_LIFECYCLE_INIT
entry.description: Plugin spawned and awaiting Ed25519 manifest check and initial heartbeat.

entry.name: POD_PLUGIN_LIFECYCLE_HEALTHY
entry.description: Plugin nominal within cgroups v2, CRC32, and heartbeat bounds.

entry.name: POD_PLUGIN_LIFECYCLE_DEGRADED
entry.description: Plugin experienced non-fatal resource pressure or transient frame drops.

entry.name: POD_PLUGIN_LIFECYCLE_OFFLINE
entry.description: Permanent mid-flight PLUGIN_OFFLINE latch on crash, OOM, CRC32 fault, or heartbeat miss (> 200 ms).

enum.name: POD_CIVIL_MISSION_CLASS
enum.description: DR-16 strictly civil/dual-use Ring-1 mission plugin taxonomy (1..5; 0 rejected as uninitialized/invalid; ACTUATOR_AUTHORITY=false).

entry.name: POD_CIVIL_MISSION_WILDFIRE_THERMAL
entry.description: Wildfire thermal hotspot and perimeter mapping.

entry.name: POD_CIVIL_MISSION_SEARCH_AND_RESCUE
entry.description: Maritime or wilderness search and rescue detection.

entry.name: POD_CIVIL_MISSION_MARITIME_ENVIRONMENTAL
entry.description: Maritime and environmental monitoring.

entry.name: POD_CIVIL_MISSION_INFRASTRUCTURE_INSPECTION
entry.description: Civil powerline and wind-turbine infrastructure inspection.

entry.name: POD_CIVIL_MISSION_MEDICAL_CARGO_LOGISTICS
entry.description: Civil medical and humanitarian cargo logistics.

message.name: POD_DAA_TRACK_ARRAY
message.description: EO+LWIR non-cooperative civil DAA primary track summary and shadow-mode avoidance advisory (zero actuator authority).
message.field: 1PPS/PTP hardware-synchronized capture timestamp.
Primary intruder azimuth in ownship FRD frame (+right).
Primary intruder elevation in ownship FRD frame (+up).
Angular bearing rate magnitude for CBDR monitoring.
Radiometric LWIR target temperature in deci-Kelvin (0 if EO-only).
Shadow-mode civil avoidance heading advisory (0..35999 cdeg).
Shadow-mode civil avoidance altitude delta advisory (cm).
Count of active fused non-cooperative civil traffic tracks.
Bitmask of EO/LWIR validity, CBDR caution, and shadow-only lock.

message.name: POD_SYNC_HEALTH
message.description: Pod 1PPS/PTP hardware synchronization, Boson+ FFC status, Jetson TTP thermal telemetry, and RTA Simplex health.
message.field: 1PPS/PTP clock offset relative to GNSS reference.
Jetson thermal transfer plate temperature in deci-Celsius.
Cumulative MIG partition dropped frame counter.
FLIR Boson+ manual FFC status.
6-camera health bitmask (0x3F = all 6 healthy: F, R, B, L, U, D).
RTA Simplex authority mode.

message.name: POD_VLM_SEMANTIC_VETO
message.description: DR-09 EASA Issue 03 IDAL-D/E semantic safety monitor advisory telemetry and relative-only FLZ candidate ranking.
message.field: Monotonic VLM inference sequence counter.
Frame capture timestamp in milliseconds since boot.
Semantic civil hazard classification.
Discretized 12-sector clock azimuth (0..11, 255=unknown).
Conformal calibration validity bit (1=valid, 0=abstain).
Deterministic 6-stage DO-178C gate verdict.
Relative-only ordered reachable FLZ candidate IDs (255=unused).

message.name: POD_PLUGIN_HEALTH
message.description: DR-16 OpenXVS-OS Ring-1 civil mission plugin health and deterministic PLUGIN_OFFLINE telemetry (48 B payload, 5 Hz, ACTUATOR_AUTHORITY=false).
message.field: FNV/SHA-truncated 64-bit Ring-1 civil plugin identifier hash.
Ring-0 monotonic timestamp in microseconds.
Last verified monotonic Ring-1 advisory sequence number.
IEEE-802.3 CRC32 over canonical wire payload bytes excluding ieee_crc32.
Cumulative missed Ring-1 heartbeat count.
Ring-1 cgroup resident set size in MiB.
Ring-1 cgroup CPU utilization in permille (1000 = 1 full core).
Plugin supervisor lifecycle state (0=INIT, 1=HEALTHY, 2=DEGRADED, 3=PLUGIN_OFFLINE).
Strictly civil mission class enum (1..5; 0 rejected as invalid).
Structurally zero-locked padding (zero actuator authority).
